title: Downloads folder
whyItMatters: Invoices, tickets, bank statements, installers and photos that were never filed away. It is the folder people forget to empty before selling a computer.
source: Windows known folder Downloads, default path under the user profile: https://support.microsoft.com/windows
notes: Known Folder Move usually does not redirect Downloads, so this folder normally holds the real files. The browser's download history and the files themselves are separate findings.

cleanup.exportFirst: Copy what you want to keep to an external drive or your cloud account before deleting anything in this folder.
steps: Open the folder named in the plan and look through it before deleting anything.
Check for the same files in OneDrive if the folder looks empty, because Known Folder Move can redirect it.
Copy what you keep to a drive you are taking with you, then delete the rest.
cleanup.risk: Anything deleted from this folder is gone unless you copied it out first. Installers can be downloaded again; statements and receipts cannot.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Support, Free up drive space in Windows: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/experience/storage-filemanagement/free-up-drive-space-in-windows
